column1: # Where the party is. APPEND ONLY — written by tools/party.py.
# Position used to live only in the DM's narration, so nothing could check a
# move. On expedition 4 round 1111 the party was walked from (19,5) to (19,6)
# through a WALL that the query output had printed on screen moments earlier.
# The player caught it by reading the printed map.
# `move` routes with mapdb/dmap.py path, which cannot cross a wall, and REFUSES
# an impossible destination instead of narrating one. `place` skips the check
# and is a separate verb so that skipping is always deliberate and visible.
